facts.text: Wind Ridge sits on Pennsylvania Route 21, just 18 miles west of Waynesburg and five miles east of the West Virginia line.
The town hosts the Jacktown Fair, a summer tradition that has celebrated 160 years of community pride and local history.
On April 8, 2024, Wind Ridge will be one of the few spots in Pennsylvania where the 2024 solar eclipse can be seen from the ground.
Stokes General Store, a family‑run deli and gas station, has been a neighborhood gathering place since the early 2000s, keeping the town’s neighborly spirit alive.
Camping in Greene County offers simple pleasures—woods, crickets, and starry skies—making Wind Ridge a perfect spot for a rustic getaway.
Winter in Wind Ridge features snow‑dusted landscapes and cozy accommodations, ideal for a peaceful seasonal escape.
